title: Test Best Practices & Tips
description: Learn patterns and guidelines to keep your tests maintainable.

slides.title: Keep Tests Isolated 🧱
slides.content:
# Each Test Should Stand Alone

- Don't rely on test order.
- Use `@BeforeEach` to set up fresh state.
- Mock external dependencies.
- Use in‑memory databases for repository tests.

quizData.question: What is a common best practice for unit tests?

options.text: Rely on test order for setup
Test multiple concerns in one test

quizData.explanation: Mocking external dependencies isolates the unit, making tests fast and reliable.

slides.title: Test Naming & Structure 📝
slides.content:
# Use Descriptive Names

Method name: `methodName_shouldExpectedBehavior_whenCondition`.

Follow **AAA** pattern:
- **Arrange** – set up objects and mocks.
- **Act** – call the method under test.
- **Assert** – verify results and interactions.

slides.title: Avoid Testing Implementation Details
slides.content: Test behavior, not internal implementation. Prefer verifying outcomes (e.g., correct return values, state changes) rather than verifying specific method calls unless necessary.
